text:
Sam: Heads-up — were provisioning three new cloud accounts for pilots next week. Need a short, copy-pasteable bootstrapping checklist that highlights GPU quota requests, networking limits (ENIs/IPs), IAM/billing setup, and required tags. Also want exact quota metric names to paste into consoles and a ticket template we can reuse.

Marta: Ill make it compact. Top-level checklist: create org/account/project + attach billing and SSO; create admin + service principals; reserve VPC subnets (CIDR plan); request GPU + network quota increases per region; enforce tags & billing export; enable quota alerts + monitoring.

Eli: Per-cloud details to include in the ticket body — copy these exact labels: 
- AWS: "Running On-Demand G instances", "Elastic network interfaces", "All IPv4 elastic addresses". Also call out EBS throughput if you plan big model stores.
- GCP: "GPUs (all regions)" or the specific accelerator like "NVIDIA A100 40GB". Also include "CPUs (vCPUs)" and external IP address quota.
- Azure: "Total Regional vCPUs" and the SKU family name (e.g., "Standard_ND_A100_v4").

Eli: AWS request pattern (paste into Support case):
```
Service: EC2 -> Category: Limit Increase
Metric: Running On-Demand G instances (specify p4/p3 or equivalent)
Region: us-west-2
Requested new limit: 8
Justification: Redwood Inference pilot - expected 150-250 GPU-hours/day. Contact infra@redwood.com.
```
CLI example for automation: 
```
aws support create-case --service-code ec2 --category-code limits --subject "Increase GPU instance quota in us-west-2" --communication-body "Requesting +8 p4d-equivalent GPUs for pilot; peak ~200 GPU-hours/day; contact infra@redwood.com" --cc-email infra@redwood.com
```

Eli: GCP flow: Console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas -> Filter by metric (e.g., "GPUs (all regions)") -> Edit quotas -> add justification. Quick check: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=PROJECT_ID` to see current quotas.

Eli: Azure flow: Help + Support -> New support request -> Quotas -> pick cores/GPU SKU -> add business justification and expected timeline. If you need specific SKU family, use the exact SKU string (e.g., "Standard_ND_A100_v4").

Jeff: Tagging + billing checklist (copyable):
- Required tags: `team`, `env` (prod/staging/dev), `project`, `cost-center`, `owner_email`.
- Billing: attach billing account and enable daily export to S3/GCS/Blob. Add cost-center mapping to billing export.
- IAM: create `infra-admin` (scoped) and `infra-ci` service accounts; enforce SSO groups and least privilege.
- KMS: create per-region CMKs for secrets and ensure services have decrypt rights only for needed keys.

Marta: Networking notes: reserve contiguous CIDR per account (prefer /22 or bigger for node autoscaling). Request ENI increases on AWS if using multi-NIC instances. On GCP, reserve secondary ranges for GKE pods and increase routes if using large clusters. For Azure, check vNet peerings and route table limits.

Marta: Monitoring & safety knobs: enable quota alarms at 60-70% usage to trigger pager and auto-ticket. Add fallback routing policy: if preferred GPU SKU unavailable, route to compatible SKU with a different model config (quantized). Pre-bake a low-cost failover image (8-bit quantized) to keep latency SLO during shortages.

Eli: Sample ticket body (one-liner you can paste):
"Business justification: Redwood pilot requires reserved GPU capacity for latency/cost validation. Request: region us-west-2 increase Running On-Demand G instances by 8 (p4/p3 equiv), ENI quota +50, Elastic IPs +10. Expected spend $XXk/month. Contact infra@redwood.com. ETA: 7 days."

Jeff: Naming policy quick rules: account IDs: `rwd-<env>-<team>-<region>`, projects: `rwd-<team>-<purpose>-<env>`. Enforce immutable tags where supported and include `owner_email` for automated routing.

Quota-bot: [auto] Created template infra/bootstrapping-1750456789 — use `/inc create` to spin up a tracking thread. :robot_face:

Sam: This is perfect. One more ask  any sanitized example of an approved AWS quota increase we can paste?

Eli: Pasted sanitized example: 
```
Subject: Increase Running On-Demand G instances in us-west-2
Body: Request increase 0 -> 8 for p4/p3 equivalence. Business case: 3-customer pilot, expected 150-250 GPU-hours/day. Contacts: infra@redwood.com, finance@redwood.com. Approval needed by 2026-03-25.
```

Sam: Thanks — Ill slot this into the onboarding template and add links to the Console flows. :raised_hands:
